values./root/FirstRoutePrototype/RouteHUD/@Pane:
ASSIGNMENT
Sealed pouch for the old ferry relay post.

OBSERVED
Route marker was turned toward the bank; now straight.
Pouch in the dry slot. Keeper absent; return mark missing.
Two-note call across river; weaker copy near the post.
Undated high-water cuts stand above today's river level.
Levee crest road links home to the river bridge.
Arrival recorded at the city courier branch.
City direction board describes the neighboring quarters.

UNKNOWN
Who made the calls, and why the return mark is missing.
When the higher water cuts were made.

REPORTED
Empty post and undated high-water marks.
